name: Teardown: Rally
summary:
A brand-new game mode and we can't wait to get you behind the wheel! Compete in quick races, tournaments and cups with a fresh lineup of speedy Rally Cars and mighty Monster Trucks, each with its own distinct handling. Find your favourite, floor it and try to remember where the brakes are.

Picture 12 players drifting across Frozen Lake, launching off massive jumps in the Quarry and making a spectacular mess of the landing. That's the kind of racing we're here for.

And who says you have to stay in the car? Hop out, wreck your opponents' vehicles and help your team take the win. Overtaking is much easier when the other car isn't going anywhere.
